entities.name: Peptide methionine sulfoxide reductase MsrA
observations: The 221-residue query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry B0UCG5 from Methylobacterium sp. strain 4-46.
Curated function: repairs oxidized protein methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide to methionine.
EC number: 1.8.4.11; Pfam PMSR domain PF01625 spans residues 46–202.

entities.name: Methionine sulfoxide reduction
observations: The enzyme catalyzes reversible reduction of protein-bound methionine sulfoxide to methionine, using reduced thioredoxin as the electron donor and producing oxidized thioredoxin.
Rhea mapping includes RHEA:14217 and RHEA:19993; reaction direction is reversible in the database annotation.
